source: https://evisa.moip.gov.mm/common-items/faq and https://evisa.moip.gov.mm/assets/dist/img/guide/userGuide.pdf, read 2026-08-30. The official FAQ and 25-page guide publish the Tourist versus Business split, eligibility counts, required supporting documents, the MRZ name instruction, at least 6 months of passport validity, JPG/PDF uploads capped at 2 MB, payment and print steps, and the four entry points. The personal-information form requires an activated account and no public text-field regexes, character limits or validation error strings were readable, so no pattern key is used and no local validator is mounted.

visa_type.label: Tourist or Business eVisa
visa_type.help: The portal has separate Tourist and Business routes. The type cannot be changed after payment, and a religious visit needs a different visa from an embassy or consulate.

errors.required: Choose the correct visa type before paying

nationality_eligibility.label: eVisa nationality eligibility
nationality_eligibility.help: The FAQ says 100 nationalities qualify for Tourist eVisa and 54 for Business eVisa. Check the list for the exact route.

passport_validity.label: Passport validity
passport_validity.help: The official guide says to verify that at least 6 months remain on the passport.

errors.required: Confirm at least 6 months of passport validity

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.help: The FAQ says the field accepts English characters only. Copy the full name from the machine-readable zone at the bottom of the passport bio page; surname and given-name order is not important if the value matches.

passport_number.label: Passport number
passport_number.placeholder: Use the passport you will carry
passport_number.help: The traveller must enter with the passport to which the eVisa was issued. Details cannot be corrected after payment.

passport_photo.label: Recent passport-sized photograph
passport_photo.help: The FAQ requires a recent digital passport-sized photograph. The guide says uploads accept JPG or PDF up to 2 MB.

errors.required: A recent passport photograph is required

passport_copy.label: Passport bio-page copy
passport_copy.placeholder: Readable scan of the bio page
passport_copy.help: The FAQ requires a scanned copy of the passport bio-data page. The guide says uploaded files accept JPG or PDF up to 2 MB.

errors.required: A passport bio-page copy is required

hotel_booking.label: Hotel booking
hotel_booking.help: The FAQ lists a hotel booking for a Tourist eVisa. Business eVisa uses company documents instead.

errors.required: A hotel booking is required for Tourist eVisa

return_ticket.label: Return ticket or Kawthaung trip evidence
return_ticket.help: Tourist applications require a return ticket. For entry at Kawthaung, the FAQ accepts boat and trip-plan evidence instead.

port_of_entry.label: eVisa port of entry
port_of_entry.placeholder: Yangon, Mandalay, Nay Pyi Taw or Kawthaung
port_of_entry.help: The current FAQ lists three international airports and Kawthaung land checkpoint. Other border crossings are not listed for eVisa entry.

errors.required: Choose an eVisa port of entry

email_and_review.label: Registered email and final review
email_and_review.help: Account activation, acknowledgment and the Approval Letter use the registered email. Review every field before payment because paid applications cannot be modified.
